units.source_text: 二月二十日左右，匂兵部卿亲王赴初濑进香。

en.t: Around the twentieth day of the second month, Prince Niou, the Hyobu-kyo, went on pilgrimage to Hatsuse.

units.source_text: 他早有此愿，多年来迁延未偿。

en.t: He had long wished to make this visit, but for many years he had put it off and left the vow unfulfilled.

units.source_text: 此次毅然实行，多分是贪图途中可在宇治泊宿之故。

en.t: His firm decision to carry it out now was probably due in large part to his desire to spend a night at Uji along the way.

units.source_text: “宇治”这个地名，有人说与“忧世”同音。

en.t: Some people say that the place name Uji has the same sound as the sorrowful world.

units.source_text: 但匂皇子自有理由来称赞这名词的可爱，真乃无稽之谈。

en.t: But Prince Niou had his own reasons for praising the name as charming, which was truly an absurd fancy.

units.source_text: 此行从者如云，许多高官贵族奉陪，殿上人自不必说，留在朝廷的人几乎没有了。

en.t: The attendants on this journey were as numerous as clouds, with many high officials and nobles accompanying him; needless to say, the courtiers came too, and almost no one was left at court.

units.source_text: 六条院主源氏传下来一处御领地，现已归夕雾右大臣所有，位在宇治川彼岸，内部非常宽敞，景致也很优美。

en.t: There was an imperial estate handed down from Genji, lord of the Rokujo estate, now owned by Yugiri, the Minister of the Right; it stood on the far bank of the Uji River, with spacious grounds and very beautiful scenery.

units.source_text: 就以此为匂皇子进香途中的招待所。

en.t: This was therefore chosen as the lodging where Prince Niou would be received during his pilgrimage.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣原定于匂皇子回来时亲赴迎候，但突然发生了不祥之事，阴阳师劝他行动小心，他就向匂皇子表示歉意。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, had originally planned to go in person to receive Prince Niou on his return, but an unlucky event suddenly occurred, and when the yin-yang diviners advised him to act cautiously, he sent his apologies to the prince.

units.source_text: 匂皇子起初稍感不快，但听说今日改由薰中将前来迎候，反而高兴起来，因为可以托他向八亲王那边传递音信，故甚称心。

en.t: Prince Niou was at first somewhat displeased, but when he heard that Kaoru, the Middle Captain, would come to receive him instead that day, he became pleased, since he could entrust Kaoru with a message to the household of the Eighth Prince, which suited him very well.

units.source_text: 原来他对夕雾右大臣向来不甚亲近，嫌他太严肃。

en.t: In fact, he had never been especially close to Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, finding him too solemn.

units.source_text: 夕雾的儿子右大弁、侍从宰相、权中将、头少将、藏人兵卫佐等皆来奉陪。

en.t: Yugiri's sons, including the Right Controller, the Consultant Chamberlain, the Provisional Middle Captain, the Head Lesser Captain, and the Chamberlain Assistant Captain of the Guards, all came to accompany him.
